description: PLUTO, the Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output, is New York City's tax-lot table of land use and building characteristics, published by the Department of City Planning; MapPLUTO joins it to the Department of Finance digital tax map polygons. The NYC Open Data table has 108 columns derived from data held by city agencies, including building class, land use, zoning districts, lot and building area by use, number of buildings, number of floors, residential and total units, year built and altered, assessed values, floor area ratios, landmark and historic district flags, and flags for the 2007 FIRM and 2015 preliminary FIRM flood zones. The current version on the portal is 26v2; the table was last updated on 24 August 2026 and the stated update frequency is quarterly, with all earlier versions kept on the DCP site. Coverage: every tax lot in the five boroughs of New York City. Access: CSV and API on NYC Open Data, and MapPLUTO polygons and all releases from the DCP dataset page, with a data dictionary. Licence: NYC Open Data terms of use; free. Caveats: values describe tax lots, not individual buildings, and several fields are administrative estimates that may lag construction. Simulation uses are building stock inputs for city energy, flood exposure and land use models, and linking other NYC datasets by the BBL lot identifier. Related records: NYC building footprints, which carry BBLs for joining.
